engines.title: Market
engines.description: Simulates human buyers and sellers forming demand, supply, prices, and responses to changing conditions.

engines.title: Council
engines.description: Simulates a bounded group sharing evidence, debating an agenda, and producing recommendations or decisions.

engines.title: Dispute
engines.description: Simulates opposing human claims, evidence, arguments, rulings, and negotiated or adjudicated resolution.

engines.title: Exchange
engines.description: Simulates configurable trading among human participants across assets, market structures, and information conditions.

engines.title: Legislature
engines.description: Supports configurable legislative bodies with motions, amendments, debate, coalitions, procedure, and voting.

engines.title: Judged Contest
engines.description: Supports participant submissions or performances followed by scoring, deliberation, and voting from human judges.

engines.title: Deliberation
engines.description: Simulates people exchanging reasons and evidence, revising views, and attempting to reach a collective conclusion.

engines.title: Negotiation
engines.description: Simulates proposals, counteroffers, concessions, constraints, agreements, and walkaways between human parties.

engines.title: Population
engines.description: Runs many sampled people through a shared situation and aggregates their individual responses and outcomes.

engines.title: Network
engines.description: Simulates human influence, trust, information sharing, and behavioral change across explicit social or organizational ties.

engines.title: Matching
engines.description: Simulates preferences, eligibility, applications, selection, pairing, and resulting human outcomes.

engines.title: Strategy
engines.description: Simulates interdependent human choices, incomplete information, cooperation, competition, and repeated consequences.
